description: Storage, demurrage or detention charge: free-time end date, chargeable days and tiered amount — Counts days between a received date and a released date for storage, demurrage, detention or parking charges: you state whether the receipt day and the release day count, how free days are counted (calendar or business days on a named or caller calendar), and a tiered per-day rate schedule by chargeable day number; returns the last free day, chargeable days, a per-tier breakdown and the total in m

calendar.description: Named holiday calendar with a source and supported date range (outside it the answer is unsupported), weekends-only (Saturday/Sunday only), or caller (only the holidays you list).

holidays.description: Extra non-business dates YYYY-MM-DD (company closures, a calendar we do not carry).

receiptDayCounts.description: Whether the day of receipt is day 1.

releaseDayCounts.description: Whether the release day is counted.

fromDay.description: Chargeable day number (1 = first day after free time) at which this rate starts; the first tier must start at 1.

rateMinor.description: Charge per day in minor units (cents).

weekend.description: Non-business weekdays, 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Default [0, 6]; use [5, 6] for a Friday/Saturday weekend.

name: storage-charge-clock
